account_type.description: Type of the account — usually 'CardDAV' for this plugin.

account_name.description: User-visible name of the account (e.g., 'Work Contacts').

carddav_url.description: Base URL of the CardDAV server (e.g., https://cards.example.com/carddav/).

user.description: Username for authentication (leave blank if using OAuth or other token-based auth).

password_ref.description: Password reference string — e.g., a secret ID or 'keyring://...' for secure storage. Never hardcode plain passwords.

display_name_value.description: Optional display name used when presenting contacts (e.g., 'My Work Address Book').

use_ssl_value.description: Whether to enforce TLS (SSL) for the connection. Must be true in production.

verify_ssl_value.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate (recommended: true).

timeout_value.description: Request timeout in seconds before the connection is aborted.

max_connections_value.description: Maximum number of concurrent HTTP connections to the CardDAV server.

supported_methods_value.description: List of HTTP methods allowed for CardDAV operations.

value.description: Value for the header (may reference variables via env-like placeholders).

custom_headers.description: List of custom HTTP headers to send with every request.

cache_enabled_value.description: Enable local caching of contact data (recommended for offline access and performance).

cache_path_value.description: Filesystem path where cached contacts are stored.

cache_ttl_value.description: Time-to-live for cache entries, in seconds.

cache_max_size_value.description: Maximum cache size in bytes (50 MB default).

sync_interval_value.description: Sync frequency in seconds (e.g., 1800 = every 30 minutes).

sync_on_connect_value.description: Trigger an immediate sync when network connectivity is restored.

sync_on_battery_value.description: Allow sync while device is running on battery (set to true for critical use cases).
